description: Remove or replace unwanted line breaks in text copied from PDFs or emails: join into one line, keep paragraph breaks, replace with comma or custom separator, rejoin hyphenated split words, trim extra spaces and drop empty lines. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/remove-line-breaks.
